WITH quarterly AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(strftime('%Y', order_date) AS INTEGER) AS yr,
    CAST((CAST(strftime('%m', order_date) AS INTEGER) - 1) / 3 + 1 AS INTEGER) AS qtr,
    region,
    category,
    customer_segment,
    SUM(revenue) AS revenue
  FROM sales
  GROUP BY yr, qtr, region, category, customer_segment
),
quarterly_totals AS (
  SELECT
    yr,
    qtr,
    SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue
  FROM quarterly
  GROUP BY yr, qtr
),
hhi_by_quarter AS (
  SELECT
    q.yr,
    q.qtr,
    SUM(q.revenue * q.revenue) / (qt.total_revenue * qt.total_revenue) AS hhi
  FROM quarterly q
  JOIN quarterly_totals qt ON q.yr = qt.yr AND q.qtr = qt.qtr
  GROUP BY q.yr, q.qtr
),
max_hhi_quarter AS (
  SELECT yr, qtr
  FROM hhi_by_quarter
  ORDER BY hhi DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
region_quarterly AS (
  SELECT
    yr,
    qtr,
    region,
    SUM(revenue) AS region_revenue
  FROM quarterly
  GROUP BY yr, qtr, region
),
region_quarterly_totals AS (
  SELECT
    yr,
    qtr,
    SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue
  FROM quarterly
  GROUP BY yr, qtr
),
region_shares AS (
  SELECT
    rq.yr,
    rq.qtr,
    rq.region,
    rq.region_revenue,
    rq.region_revenue / rqt.total_revenue AS region_share
  FROM region_quarterly rq
  JOIN region_quarterly_totals rqt ON rq.yr = rqt.yr AND rq.qtr = rqt.qtr
),
target_region AS (
  SELECT region
  FROM region_shares
  WHERE yr = (SELECT yr FROM max_hhi_quarter) AND qtr = (SELECT qtr FROM max_hhi_quarter)
  ORDER BY region_share DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
cat_seg_quarterly AS (
  SELECT
    yr,
    qtr,
    category,
    customer_segment,
    SUM(revenue) AS revenue
  FROM quarterly
  GROUP BY yr, qtr, category, customer_segment
),
cat_seg_quarterly_totals AS (
  SELECT
    yr,
    qtr,
    SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue
  FROM quarterly
  GROUP BY yr, qtr
),
cat_seg_shares AS (
  SELECT
    csq.yr,
    csq.qtr,
    csq.category,
    csq.customer_segment,
    csq.revenue,
    csq.revenue / csqt.total_revenue AS share
  FROM cat_seg_quarterly csq
  JOIN cat_seg_quarterly_totals csqt ON csq.yr = csqt.yr AND csq.qtr = csqt.qtr
),
target_cat_seg AS (
  SELECT category, customer_segment
  FROM cat_seg_shares
  WHERE yr = (SELECT yr FROM max_hhi_quarter) AND qtr = (SELECT qtr FROM max_hhi_quarter)
  ORDER BY share DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
all_quarters AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT yr, qtr
  FROM quarterly
),
target_region_cat_seg AS (
  SELECT
    q.yr,
    q.qtr,
    q.region,
    q.category,
    q.customer_segment,
    q.revenue
  FROM quarterly q
  JOIN target_region tr ON q.region = tr.region
  JOIN target_cat_seg tcs ON q.category = tcs.category AND q.customer_segment = tcs.customer_segment
),
target_region_totals AS (
  SELECT
    yr,
    qtr,
    SUM(revenue) AS region_total
  FROM quarterly
  WHERE region = (SELECT region FROM target_region)
  GROUP BY yr, qtr
),
target_region_cat_seg_share AS (
  SELECT
    trcs.yr,
    trcs.qtr,
    trcs.region,
    trcs.category,
    trcs.customer_segment,
    trcs.revenue,
    trcs.revenue / trt.region_total AS share_within_region
  FROM target_region_cat_seg trcs
  JOIN target_region_totals trt ON trcs.yr = trt.yr AND trcs.qtr = trt.qtr
),
target_region_cat_seg_share_overall AS (
  SELECT
    trcs.yr,
    trcs.qtr,
    trcs.region,
    trcs.category,
    trcs.customer_segment,
    trcs.revenue,
    trcs.revenue / qt.total_revenue AS share_overall
  FROM target_region_cat_seg trcs
  JOIN quarterly_totals qt ON trcs.yr = qt.yr AND trcs.qtr = qt.qtr
)
SELECT
  trcs.yr,
  trcs.qtr,
  trcs.region,
  trcs.category,
  trcs.customer_segment,
  trcs.revenue,
  trcs.share_within_region,
  trcs_ov.share_overall,
  hq.hhi
FROM target_region_cat_seg_share trcs
JOIN target_region_cat_seg_share_overall trcs_ov
  ON trcs.yr = trcs_ov.yr AND trcs.qtr = trcs_ov.qtr
  AND trcs.region = trcs_ov.region AND trcs.category = trcs_ov.category AND trcs.customer_segment = trcs_ov.customer_segment
JOIN hhi_by_quarter hq ON trcs.yr = hq.yr AND trcs.qtr = hq.qtr
ORDER BY trcs.yr, trcs.qtr

key_findings.statement: Online 渠道的季度每件收入波动最大，极差为 247.16，高于 Direct 渠道的 218.9。
Online 渠道各渠道的平均每件收入在 276.55 至 279.43 之间，最高每件收入达 415.33，最低为 148.01。
在 Online 渠道中，West 地区的每件收入波动最大，从 95.35 升至 471.785，增幅达 394.79%，是地区维度波动的主要来源。
Online 渠道中 North 地区每件收入从 394.44 降至 273.544，降幅 30.65%；South 地区从 133.02 升至 250.34，增幅 88.19%；East 地区从 139.59 升至 240.19，增幅 72.07%。
Online 渠道中 Team Training 产品的波动率最高，达 97.15，其每件收入从 525.85 降至 508.92（降幅 3.22%），是产品维度波动的主要来源。
Online 渠道中 Migration Pack 产品波动率次高，达 83.85，其每件收入从 389.80 升至 424.76（增幅 8.97%）。

limitations: 分析基于提供的季度汇总数据，未包含更细粒度的时间维度（如月度或周度），可能遗漏短期波动。

recommended_actions: 针对 Online 渠道 West 地区每件收入的大幅波动，建议深入调查其价格策略或产品组合变化，以稳定收入水平。
关注 Team Training 产品在 Online 渠道的波动，评估是否需要调整定价或促销策略以维持收入稳定性。
进一步分析 Online 渠道中服务类与硬件类收入占比的变化，优化产品组合以降低每件收入的波动性。

WITH segment_region_revenue AS (
  SELECT customer_segment, region, SUM(revenue) AS seg_reg_revenue
  FROM sales
  GROUP BY customer_segment, region
),
overall_revenue AS (
  SELECT SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM sales
),
segment_region_share AS (
  SELECT sr.customer_segment, sr.region, sr.seg_reg_revenue,
         sr.seg_reg_revenue / o.total_revenue AS seg_reg_share
  FROM segment_region_revenue AS sr
  CROSS JOIN overall_revenue AS o
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(seg_reg_share) AS avg_share FROM segment_region_share
),
expected_revenue AS (
  SELECT sr.customer_segment, sr.region, sr.seg_reg_revenue,
         o.total_revenue * a.avg_share AS expected_revenue
  FROM segment_region_revenue AS sr
  CROSS JOIN overall_revenue AS o
  CROSS JOIN avg_share AS a
),
deviation AS (
  SELECT customer_segment, region, seg_reg_revenue, expected_revenue,
         seg_reg_revenue - expected_revenue AS deviation,
         (seg_reg_revenue - expected_revenue) / NULLIF(expected_revenue, 0) AS deviation_pct
  FROM expected_revenue
),
top_combos AS (
  SELECT customer_segment, region, deviation, deviation_pct
  FROM deviation
  ORDER BY ABS(deviation_pct) DESC
  LIMIT 2
),
combo_product AS (
  SELECT s.customer_segment, s.region, s.product, s.category,
         SUM(s.revenue) AS combo_product_revenue
  FROM sales AS s
  JOIN top_combos AS tc ON s.customer_segment = tc.customer_segment AND s.region = tc.region
  GROUP BY s.customer_segment, s.region, s.product, s.category
),
combo_total AS (
  SELECT customer_segment, region, SUM(combo_product_revenue) AS combo_total_revenue
  FROM combo_product
  GROUP BY customer_segment, region
),
overall_product AS (
  SELECT product, category, SUM(revenue) AS overall_product_revenue
  FROM sales
  GROUP BY product, category
),
overall_total AS (
  SELECT SUM(revenue) AS overall_total_revenue FROM sales
),
combo_share AS (
  SELECT cp.customer_segment, cp.region, cp.product, cp.category,
         cp.combo_product_revenue,
         cp.combo_product_revenue / ct.combo_total_revenue AS combo_share
  FROM combo_product AS cp
  JOIN combo_total AS ct ON cp.customer_segment = ct.customer_segment AND cp.region = ct.region
),
overall_share AS (
  SELECT op.product, op.category, op.overall_product_revenue,
         op.overall_product_revenue / ot.overall_total_revenue AS overall_share
  FROM overall_product AS op
  CROSS JOIN overall_total AS ot
)
SELECT cs.customer_segment, cs.region, cs.product, cs.category,
       cs.combo_product_revenue,
       ROUND(cs.combo_share, 4) AS combo_share,
       ROUND(os.overall_share, 4) AS overall_share,
       ROUND(cs.combo_share - os.overall_share, 4) AS share_diff,
       ROUND((cs.combo_share - os.overall_share) / NULLIF(os.overall_share, 0), 4) AS share_ratio_diff
FROM combo_share AS cs
JOIN overall_share AS os ON cs.product = os.product AND cs.category = os.category
ORDER BY cs.customer_segment, cs.region, ABS(cs.combo_share - os.overall_share) DESC

WITH dept_stats AS (
  SELECT department, AVG(salary) AS avg_salary, AVG(performance_score) AS avg_performance, COUNT(*) AS emp_count
  FROM employees
  GROUP BY department
),
dept_match AS (
  SELECT department, avg_salary, avg_performance, emp_count,
    ABS(avg_salary - (SELECT AVG(salary) FROM employees)) / (SELECT AVG(salary) FROM employees) AS salary_dev,
    ABS(avg_performance - (SELECT AVG(performance_score) FROM employees)) / (SELECT AVG(performance_score) FROM employees) AS perf_dev,
    (ABS(avg_salary - (SELECT AVG(salary) FROM employees)) / (SELECT AVG(salary) FROM employees)) + (ABS(avg_performance - (SELECT AVG(performance_score) FROM employees)) / (SELECT AVG(performance_score) FROM employees)) AS total_deviation
  FROM dept_stats
),
weakest_dept AS (
  SELECT department FROM dept_match ORDER BY total_deviation DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT e.department,
  CASE
    WHEN e.performance_score >= 4.5 AND e.salary >= (SELECT AVG(salary) FROM employees) * 1.2 THEN 'high_salary_high_perf'
    WHEN e.performance_score >= 4.5 AND e.salary < (SELECT AVG(salary) FROM employees) * 0.8 THEN 'low_salary_high_perf'
    WHEN e.performance_score < 3.0 AND e.salary >= (SELECT AVG(salary) FROM employees) * 1.2 THEN 'high_salary_low_perf'
    WHEN e.performance_score < 3.0 AND e.salary < (SELECT AVG(salary) FROM employees) * 0.8 THEN 'low_salary_low_perf'
    ELSE 'aligned'
  END AS salary_perf_category,
  COUNT(*) AS emp_count,
  ROUND(AVG(e.salary), 0) AS avg_salary,
  ROUND(AVG(e.performance_score), 2) AS avg_performance,
  ROUND(MIN(e.salary), 0) AS min_salary,
  ROUND(MAX(e.salary), 0) AS max_salary,
  ROUND(MIN(e.performance_score), 2) AS min_performance,
  ROUND(MAX(e.performance_score), 2) AS max_performance
FROM employees AS e
WHERE e.department IN (SELECT department FROM weakest_dept)
GROUP BY e.department, salary_perf_category
ORDER BY emp_count DESC

result.insight:
**观察：** 在平均折扣率最高的前8个类别与渠道组合中，Audio/Online 以约7.31%的平均折扣率位居首位，其次是 Computing/Partner（约6.95%）和 Video/Direct（约6.74%）。其余组合的平均折扣率在6.29%至6.69%之间，整体差异不大（最高与最低相差约1.03个百分点）。Online渠道出现在2个组合中（Audio、Accessories），Partner渠道出现在4个组合中（Computing、Video、Displays、Audio），Direct渠道出现在2个组合中（Video、Networking）。

**谨慎解读：** 数据表明不同类别在不同渠道上的平均折扣率存在一定差异，但整体折扣水平均较低（均未超过8%）。Partner渠道在前8名中占比最高，可能暗示该渠道整体折扣力度相对较大，但这需要结合全量数据（而非仅前8名）才能确认。Online渠道中Audio和Accessories的折扣率较高，可能反映这些品类在线上渠道有更积极的促销策略。

**因果限制：** 本分析仅基于平均折扣率的排序，无法推断渠道或类别本身对折扣率的因果影响。折扣率可能受促销活动、库存状况、季节性因素、产品定价策略等多种未纳入分析的变量影响。此外，平均折扣率未考虑订单量或销售额的加权，高销量组合的实际折扣影响可能被低估或高估。

  SELECT o.id AS order_id, SUM(oi.line_revenue) AS order_revenue

)

  CASE WHEN rf.order_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'with_refund' ELSE 'without_refund' END AS refund_status,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS order_count,
  AVG(rev.order_revenue) AS avg_order_revenue
FROM orders AS o

LEFT JOIN order_revenue AS rev ON rev.order_id = o.id

ORDER BY order_count DESC

key_findings.statement: Partner渠道在订单状态分布中占据主导地位，其渠道内订单占比最高达56.73%，同时异常率最高达8.62%，表明Partner渠道是运营失衡最集中的渠道。
Partner渠道在订单状态-渠道组合中同时出现在最高和最低订单量两端（最高98单、最低7单），说明其内部状态分布极不均衡，存在明显的结构性偏差。
Partner渠道在退款维度上异常集中，退款笔数最高达12笔，退款总额最高达32833.95，平均退款金额最高达2736.16，均显著高于其他渠道组合。
退款原因以"Incorrect item"为主，该原因在退款原因排序中同时出现在首位和末位，说明其覆盖了多个渠道组合，是退款的核心驱动因素。
Partner渠道在商品结构上存在偏差，其渠道内商品类别订单量占比最高达20.43%，而整体占比最高达22.57%，渠道与整体商品结构占比差异最大达-5.37个百分点，显示商品结构在Partner渠道中与整体存在偏移。
Direct渠道在订单状态-渠道组合中订单量最高达87单，且其渠道内占比最高达56.73%，与Partner渠道共同构成订单的主要来源，但Direct渠道的退款笔数最低（3笔），退款异常相对较轻。
